create_class_BytesList: create a BytesList protobuf message with a list of byte values
create_class_FloatList: create a FloatList protobuf message with a list of float values
create_class_Int64List: create an Int64List protobuf message with a list of int64 values
create_class_Feature: create a Feature protobuf message with bytes_list, float_list, or int64_list kind
create_class_Features: create a Features protobuf message mapping feature names to Feature values
